thread:
Keita: Alert: dozens of prod-ml bootstrap jobs started failing around 2026-09-01T11:05Z with 403s when reading keystore secrets. new keystore policy rolled at ~11:00.
Hannah: Confirmed in eu-central and us-west-2. Nodes unable to unwrap model keys -> fail kube join -> autoscaler churn.
Luis: Example log from init container:
```
2026-09-01T11:06:12Z init: vault read status=403 path=secret/data/prod/keystore/node-token
error=permission denied policy=keystore-canary-2026-09-01
```
Ravi (security): We ran a canary that should have validated role mappings, but the canary job used a newer service account name. the production artifact role was still under the old name, so mapping check passed but prod failed.
Keita: Ouch. So the canary validation was false-positive due to SA name mismatch. Now we're seeing node bootstrap failures and the cost team pinged about on-demand GPUs.
ops-bot: Cost alert: GPU spend +92% vs baseline (us-west-2) at 11:20 UTC.
Hannah: Immediate mitigation: mint a scoped fallback token limited to the legacy path and TTL 45m, inject into infra bootstrap secret, and re-enable audit exporter (it was paused during the rollout).
Luis: Running commands (dry-run then apply):
```
vault policy write tmp-legacy-bootstrap - <<EOF
path "secret/data/prod/keystore/node-token" {
  capabilities = ["read"]
}
EOF
vault token create -policy=tmp-legacy-bootstrap -orphan -ttl=45m
kubectl -n infra create secret generic fallback-bootstrap-token --from-literal=token=<token> --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -
```
Ravi (security): I'll sign the emergency exception and record it. Also re-enable audit exporter now; we need full trails for compliance.
Maya (compliance): Please capture the timeline and list of affected node IDs. we'll need an exception report for regulators because audit was paused during the rollout window.
Keita: Token injected. seeing bootstrap successes -> nodes starting to join warm pool. Warm capacity trending up, autoscaler stabilization in progress.
ops-bot: Audit exporter: enabled.
Hannah: Cost alert downgraded at 11:50 but still above baseline. We'll monitor for the next 2 hours.
Ravi (security): Follow-ups: (1) make canary use the exact prod service account aliases or run the canary against a prod-like SA matrix, (2) implement an automated SA-name check in the policy-diff validator, (3) require that audit-exporter pause steps are recorded in the rollout playbook and require two approvals.
Keita: Opening ticket PLT-9999 and assigning owners. ops-bot created incident INC-2026-0901-KEYSTORE-CANARY. Closing thread when costs stabilize and playbook edits land.
